meaning.hi: Message handset par successfully deliver ho gaya.
meaning.en: The message was delivered to the handset successfully.

hi: Koi action ki zaroorat nahi.
en: No action needed.

meaning.hi: Problem receiver ke number / phone me hai - jaise phone band, network se bahar, inbox full, number invalid ya service barred.
meaning.en: The issue is on the receiver's number / phone - e.g. phone switched off, out of coverage, inbox full, invalid number or barred service.

hi: Number sahi hai (10 digit, country code ke saath) confirm karein.
Phone on aur network me aane par SMS kuch der baad deliver ho sakta hai - dobara try karein.
Baar-baar fail ho to number invalid / inactive ho sakta hai - list se hata dein.
en: Confirm the number is correct (10 digits, with country code).
The SMS may deliver later when the phone is on and in coverage - retry after some time.
If it keeps failing, the number may be invalid / inactive - remove it from your list.

meaning.hi: Operator network ya signalling level par temporary technical problem aayi (congestion, timeout, route issue, etc.).
meaning.en: A temporary technical problem occurred at the operator network / signalling level (congestion, timeout, routing issue, etc.).

hi: Kuch der (10-15 minute) baad dobara bhej kar dekhein - aksar temporary hota hai.
Sirf kuch numbers par ho to woh number / operator issue ho sakta hai.
Zyada SMS fail ho rahe hon to Error Code, Message ID aur time ke saath support ko batayein.
en: Retry after some time (10-15 minutes) - it is usually temporary.
If only a few numbers are affected, it may be a number / operator issue.
If many SMS are failing, report to support with the Error Code, Message ID and time.

meaning.hi: Receiver ne DND / preference set kar rakhi hai ya message ka type / time us preference ke against hai, isliye block hua.
meaning.en: The receiver has DND / preferences set, or the message type / time goes against that preference, so it was blocked.

hi: Promotional SMS DND number par nahi jaata - sirf Transactional / Service template use karein jahan allowed ho.
Promotional SMS sirf allowed time (10 AM - 9 PM) me bhejein.
Number par consent ho to DLT me consent register karein.
Aise numbers ko apni list se hata dein.
en: Promotional SMS cannot go to DND numbers - use Transactional / Service templates where allowed.
Send promotional SMS only within the allowed time (10 AM - 9 PM).
If you have consent for the number, register it on DLT.
Remove such numbers from your list.

description: MESSAGE CONTENT IS BLACKLISTED/EC_Network System Failure

meaning.hi: SMS ka content DLT par registered template se match nahi hua, ya template inactive / blacklisted / not found hai.
meaning.en: The SMS content did not match the template registered on DLT, or the template is inactive / blacklisted / not found.

hi: Panel me sahi Template ID select / daala hai, confirm karein.
SMS text DLT template se word-to-word match hona chahiye; sirf {#var#} wali jagah badal sakti hai.
Variable ki length DLT me di gayi limit se zyada na ho.
DLT par template ka status Active / Approved dekhein.
Fix ke baad dobara bhejein. Phir bhi fail ho to Template ID + message ka text support ko bhejein.
en: Make sure the correct Template ID is selected / entered in the panel.
The SMS text must match the DLT template word for word; only the {#var#} parts may change.
Variable values must not exceed the length allowed on DLT.
Check that the template status on DLT is Active / Approved.
Send again after the fix. If it still fails, share the Template ID and message text with support.

Sirf kuch numbers par ho to woh number / operator issue ho sakta hai.
Zyada SMS fail ho rahe hon to Error Code, Message ID aur time ke saath support ko batayein.
en: Retry after some time (10-15 minutes) - it is usually temporary.
If only a few numbers are affected, it may be a number / operator issue.
If many SMS are failing, report to support with the Error Code, Message ID and time.

hi: Ye mostly platform / DLT chain setting ka issue hota hai - support team ko Error Code aur Message ID ke saath batayein.
DLT portal par apna Telemarketer binding (PE-TM chain) check karein.
Support se chain update hone ke baad dobara test karein.
en: This is mostly a platform / DLT chain setting issue - report it to support with the Error Code and Message ID.
Check your Telemarketer binding (PE-TM chain) on the DLT portal.
Re-test after support updates the chain.

meaning.hi: Platform ke andar temporary technical problem aayi (system / queue / database / timeout).

hi: Thodi der baad dobara try karein.

en: Please retry after a short while.

meaning.hi: Jo Header (Sender ID) aapne use kiya woh DLT par registered / active nahi hai, ya is template ke saath linked nahi hai.
meaning.en: The Header (Sender ID) you used is not registered / active on DLT, or is not linked to this template.

hi: Panel me jo Header select kiya hai, DLT par bilkul wahi spelling (case-sensitive) me registered hai ya nahi dekhein.
DLT par Header ka status Active hona chahiye (Inactive / Suspended / Blacklisted nahi).
Template ke saath Header linked hona chahiye - DLT par template details check karein.
Sahi Header select karke dobara SMS bhejein.
en: Check that the Header selected in the panel is registered on DLT with the exact spelling (case-sensitive).
The Header status on DLT must be Active (not Inactive / Suspended / Blacklisted).
The Header must be linked with the template - verify the template details on DLT.
Select the correct Header and send again.

meaning.hi: Aapki company ka DLT Entity (PE) registration SMS ke liye valid nahi mila (not found / inactive / blacklisted / mismatch).
meaning.en: Your company's DLT Entity (PE) registration was not valid for this SMS (not found / inactive / blacklisted / mismatch).

hi: DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) me apna Entity ID ka status check karein - Active hona chahiye.
Panel me jo Entity ID laga hai wahi DLT wala hai, confirm karein.
Agar inactive / blacklisted / expired hai to DLT operator se reactivate / renew karwayein.
Fix hone ke baad ek test SMS bhej kar check karein. Problem rahe to Entity ID ke saath support ko batayein.
en: Check your Entity ID status on the DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) - it must be Active.
Confirm that the Entity ID configured in the panel is the same as on DLT.
If it is inactive / blacklisted / expired, get it reactivated or renewed from your DLT operator.
Send a test SMS after the fix. If it still fails, share the Entity ID with support.

meaning.hi: SMS ka content DLT par registered template se match nahi hua, ya template inactive / blacklisted / not found hai.
meaning.en: The SMS content did not match the template registered on DLT, or the template is inactive / blacklisted / not found.

hi: Panel me sahi Template ID select / daala hai, confirm karein.
SMS text DLT template se word-to-word match hona chahiye; sirf {#var#} wali jagah badal sakti hai.
Variable ki length DLT me di gayi limit se zyada na ho.
DLT par template ka status Active / Approved dekhein.
Fix ke baad dobara bhejein. Phir bhi fail ho to Template ID + message ka text support ko bhejein.
en: Make sure the correct Template ID is selected / entered in the panel.
The SMS text must match the DLT template word for word; only the {#var#} parts may change.
Variable values must not exceed the length allowed on DLT.
Check that the template status on DLT is Active / Approved.
Send again after the fix. If it still fails, share the Template ID and message text with support.

hi: Sabse pehle DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) par apna URL whitelist (CTA) karwayein - iske baad hi SMS jayega.

Template ka text DLT par approved text se match hona chahiye.
Whitelist hone ke baad dobara SMS bhejein. Phir bhi fail ho to Error Code, URL aur Template ID ke saath support1@nimbusitsolutions.com par mail karein.

Use exactly the URL that was whitelisted in the SMS / template (if it is a short link or landing page link, get that exact link whitelisted).

Send the SMS again after whitelisting. If it still fails, mail support1@nimbusitsolutions.com with the Error Code, URL and Template ID.

description: No record found with header (case sensitive) as primary key

meaning.hi: Jo Header (Sender ID) aapne use kiya woh DLT par registered / active nahi hai, ya is template ke saath linked nahi hai.
meaning.en: The Header (Sender ID) you used is not registered / active on DLT, or is not linked to this template.

hi: Panel me jo Header select kiya hai, DLT par bilkul wahi spelling (case-sensitive) me registered hai ya nahi dekhein.
DLT par Header ka status Active hona chahiye (Inactive / Suspended / Blacklisted nahi).
Template ke saath Header linked hona chahiye - DLT par template details check karein.
Sahi Header select karke dobara SMS bhejein.
en: Check that the Header selected in the panel is registered on DLT with the exact spelling (case-sensitive).
The Header status on DLT must be Active (not Inactive / Suspended / Blacklisted).
The Header must be linked with the template - verify the template details on DLT.
Select the correct Header and send again.

hi: DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) me apna Entity ID ka status check karein - Active hona chahiye.
Panel me jo Entity ID laga hai wahi DLT wala hai, confirm karein.
Agar inactive / blacklisted / expired hai to DLT operator se reactivate / renew karwayein.
Fix hone ke baad ek test SMS bhej kar check karein. Problem rahe to Entity ID ke saath support ko batayein.
en: Check your Entity ID status on the DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) - it must be Active.
Confirm that the Entity ID configured in the panel is the same as on DLT.
If it is inactive / blacklisted / expired, get it reactivated or renewed from your DLT operator.
Send a test SMS after the fix. If it still fails, share the Entity ID with support.

description: No record found with Template Id as primary key/no template found

meaning.hi: SMS ka content DLT par registered template se match nahi hua, ya template inactive / blacklisted / not found hai.
meaning.en: The SMS content did not match the template registered on DLT, or the template is inactive / blacklisted / not found.

hi: Panel me sahi Template ID select / daala hai, confirm karein.
SMS text DLT template se word-to-word match hona chahiye; sirf {#var#} wali jagah badal sakti hai.
Variable ki length DLT me di gayi limit se zyada na ho.
DLT par template ka status Active / Approved dekhein.
Fix ke baad dobara bhejein. Phir bhi fail ho to Template ID + message ka text support ko bhejein.
en: Make sure the correct Template ID is selected / entered in the panel.
The SMS text must match the DLT template word for word; only the {#var#} parts may change.
Variable values must not exceed the length allowed on DLT.
Check that the template status on DLT is Active / Approved.
Send again after the fix. If it still fails, share the Template ID and message text with support.

description: Blocked in preferences with MSISDN as PK.

meaning.hi: Receiver ne DND / preference set kar rakhi hai ya message ka type / time us preference ke against hai, isliye block hua.
meaning.en: The receiver has DND / preferences set, or the message type / time goes against that preference, so it was blocked.

hi: Promotional SMS DND number par nahi jaata - sirf Transactional / Service template use karein jahan allowed ho.
Promotional SMS sirf allowed time (10 AM - 9 PM) me bhejein.
Number par consent ho to DLT me consent register karein.
Aise numbers ko apni list se hata dein.
en: Promotional SMS cannot go to DND numbers - use Transactional / Service templates where allowed.
Send promotional SMS only within the allowed time (10 AM - 9 PM).
If you have consent for the number, register it on DLT.
Remove such numbers from your list.

meaning.hi: Promotional SMS ke liye block time (raat 9 PM se subah 10 AM) me bheja gaya.
meaning.en: A promotional SMS was sent during the block hours (9 PM to 10 AM).

hi: Promotional SMS sirf 10 AM se 9 PM ke beech bhejein.
Raat ke SMS ke liye Transactional / OTP template use karein.
en: Send promotional SMS only between 10 AM and 9 PM.
Use Transactional / OTP templates for night-time messages.

description: SE category blocking on fully DND, if consent not available

meaning.hi: Is number ke liye aapka DLT consent mojood nahi / expired / revoked / invalid hai.
meaning.en: A valid DLT consent for this number is missing / expired / revoked / invalid.

hi: Check karein ki customer ne aapko SMS ke liye consent diya hai.
DLT portal par consent register / renew karein (promotional / service explicit ke liye zaroori).
Revoked consent wale number par SMS na bhejein.
Consent update hone ke baad dobara bhejein.
en: Confirm that the customer has given consent to receive your SMS.
Register / renew the consent on the DLT portal (required for promotional / service-explicit messages).
Do not send SMS to numbers whose consent is revoked.
Send again after the consent is updated.

hi: Panel me jo Header select kiya hai, DLT par bilkul wahi spelling (case-sensitive) me registered hai ya nahi dekhein.
DLT par Header ka status Active hona chahiye (Inactive / Suspended / Blacklisted nahi).
Template ke saath Header linked hona chahiye - DLT par template details check karein.
Sahi Header select karke dobara SMS bhejein.

The Header status on DLT must be Active (not Inactive / Suspended / Blacklisted).
The Header must be linked with the template - verify the template details on DLT.
Select the correct Header and send again.

meaning.en: The SMS contains a link but no URL / CTA is whitelisted on DLT.

hi: Sabse pehle DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) par apna URL whitelist (CTA) karwayein - iske baad hi SMS jayega.
SMS / template me wahi URL use karein jo whitelist hua hai (short link ya landing page link ho to wahi link whitelist karwayein).
Template ka text DLT par approved text se match hona chahiye.
Whitelist hone ke baad dobara SMS bhejein. Phir bhi fail ho to Error Code, URL aur Template ID ke saath support1@nimbusitsolutions.com par mail karein.
en: First get your URL whitelisted (CTA) on the DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) - only then will the SMS go through.
Use exactly the URL that was whitelisted in the SMS / template (if it is a short link or landing page link, get that exact link whitelisted).
The template text must match the text approved on DLT.
Send the SMS again after whitelisting. If it still fails, mail support1@nimbusitsolutions.com with the Error Code, URL and Template ID.

Retry after 5-10 minutes.
Contact support if you need a higher speed limit.

If you have consent for the number, register it on DLT.
Remove such numbers from your list.

Agar inactive / blacklisted / expired hai to DLT operator se reactivate / renew karwayein.
Fix hone ke baad ek test SMS bhej kar check karein. Problem rahe to Entity ID ke saath support ko batayein.
en: Check your Entity ID status on the DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) - it must be Active.

Send a test SMS after the fix. If it still fails, share the Entity ID with support.

SMS text DLT template se word-to-word match hona chahiye; sirf {#var#} wali jagah badal sakti hai.

description: CTA whitelisting error. which indicates that the used URL is not whitelisted over DLT

meaning.hi: CTA whitelisting error - SMS me use hua URL DLT par whitelist nahi hai.
meaning.en: CTA whitelisting error - the URL used in the SMS is not whitelisted on DLT.

hi: Sabse pehle DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) par apna URL whitelist (CTA) karwayein - iske baad hi SMS jayega.
SMS / template me wahi URL use karein jo whitelist hua hai (short link ya landing page link ho to wahi link whitelist karwayein).
Template ka text DLT par approved text se match hona chahiye.
Whitelist hone ke baad dobara SMS bhejein. Phir bhi fail ho to Error Code, URL aur Template ID ke saath support1@nimbusitsolutions.com par mail karein.
en: First get your URL whitelisted (CTA) on the DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) - only then will the SMS go through.
Use exactly the URL that was whitelisted in the SMS / template (if it is a short link or landing page link, get that exact link whitelisted).
The template text must match the text approved on DLT.
Send the SMS again after whitelisting. If it still fails, mail support1@nimbusitsolutions.com with the Error Code, URL and Template ID.

en: Do not use this URL in the SMS; find out the blacklist reason from DLT / support.
Get another (clean) URL whitelisted on DLT and use it.
Mail support1@nimbusitsolutions.com with the Error Code and URL.

meaning.hi: Aapki company ka DLT Entity (PE) registration SMS ke liye valid nahi mila (not found / inactive / blacklisted / mismatch).
meaning.en: Your company's DLT Entity (PE) registration was not valid for this SMS (not found / inactive / blacklisted / mismatch).

hi: DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) me apna Entity ID ka status check karein - Active hona chahiye.
Panel me jo Entity ID laga hai wahi DLT wala hai, confirm karein.
Agar inactive / blacklisted / expired hai to DLT operator se reactivate / renew karwayein.
Fix hone ke baad ek test SMS bhej kar check karein. Problem rahe to Entity ID ke saath support ko batayein.
en: Check your Entity ID status on the DLT portal (Jio / Airtel / Vi / BSNL) - it must be Active.
Confirm that the Entity ID configured in the panel is the same as on DLT.
If it is inactive / blacklisted / expired, get it reactivated or renewed from your DLT operator.
Send a test SMS after the fix. If it still fails, share the Entity ID with support.

hi: Panel me jo Header select kiya hai, DLT par bilkul wahi spelling (case-sensitive) me registered hai ya nahi dekhein.
DLT par Header ka status Active hona chahiye (Inactive / Suspended / Blacklisted nahi).
Template ke saath Header linked hona chahiye - DLT par template details check karein.
Sahi Header select karke dobara SMS bhejein.
en: Check that the Header selected in the panel is registered on DLT with the exact spelling (case-sensitive).
The Header status on DLT must be Active (not Inactive / Suspended / Blacklisted).
The Header must be linked with the template - verify the template details on DLT.
Select the correct Header and send again.

meaning.en: SMS were sent too fast / too many, or repeatedly to the same number, so a limit was applied.

hi: Sending speed kam karein aur batches me bhejein.
Ek hi number par kam samay me baar-baar SMS na bhejein.
5-10 minute baad dobara try karein.
Speed limit badhwani ho to support se baat karein.
en: Reduce the sending speed and send in smaller batches.
Avoid sending repeatedly to the same number in a short time.
Retry after 5-10 minutes.
Contact support if you need a higher speed limit.

meaning.hi: SMS ka content DLT par registered template se match nahi hua, ya template inactive / blacklisted / not found hai.
meaning.en: The SMS content did not match the template registered on DLT, or the template is inactive / blacklisted / not found.

hi: Panel me sahi Template ID select / daala hai, confirm karein.
SMS text DLT template se word-to-word match hona chahiye; sirf {#var#} wali jagah badal sakti hai.
Variable ki length DLT me di gayi limit se zyada na ho.
DLT par template ka status Active / Approved dekhein.
Fix ke baad dobara bhejein. Phir bhi fail ho to Template ID + message ka text support ko bhejein.
en: Make sure the correct Template ID is selected / entered in the panel.
The SMS text must match the DLT template word for word; only the {#var#} parts may change.
Variable values must not exceed the length allowed on DLT.
Check that the template status on DLT is Active / Approved.
Send again after the fix. If it still fails, share the Template ID and message text with support.
